initialExam.title: OPSC OCS 2026 (Odisha Civil Service)
initialExam.description: Odisha Civil Service examination conducted by OPSC for recruitment to Group A and Group B civil service posts in Odisha state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies, CSAT. Mains: Odia Language, English, Essay, General Studies Papers, Optional.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: OAS Officer, OPS Officer, and other Group A/B posts in Odisha
initialExam.careerGrowth: Sub-Collector → Additional Collector → District Collector → Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit opsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Government quarters, Pension
